title: Selected width when the formula evaluates to one
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on $n$ coordinates, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. If $\varphi$ does not evaluate to $-1$ at $x$, then the selected term has width zero.
